description: Hierarchical Decomposition Flow by Office Solution The Hierarchical Decomposition Flow visualizes multi-level categorical breakdowns and numerical contributions in Power BI. It displays data as a dynamic, interactive tree structure, where each node represents a category or path segment. Integrated waterfall mechanics and variance indicators reveal the positive and negative impacts on your total measure as you drill down into lower levels of the hierarchy. Key Concepts: Hierarchical Nodes: Expanding blocks representing dimensions in the path, with visual cues for relative contribution. Contribution & Variance: Node styling and supplemental charts indicating positive (green) or negative (red) impacts on the total measure. Comparison Layout: Split-screen capabilities to simultaneously compare two periods, budgets, or scenarios side-by-side. Key Features: Dynamic Field Switching: Swap out value measures (e.g., Revenue to Gross Margin) or hierarchy paths instantly via the top toolbar dropdowns without altering the visual pane. Interactive Compare Mode: Toggle a side-by-side view to compare Period A vs Period B structures. Mini Waterfall Details Drawer: Click on any node to slide out a detailed waterfall chart explaining its specific variances and composition.
